resources.string: Calendar synchronization will become available in a later version.
These preferences apply only to Calendeer. Other calendar apps and event content stay unchanged.
Independent application, not affiliated with Proton.

Create simple events from your calendar app, without reminders, guests, recurrence or custom colors. Changes stay local unless title synchronization is explicitly enabled. Deletions are not sent to Proton.

Titles only: timed or all-day events without repeats, reminders, guests or custom colors. Includes events imported from Proton and those created in Android after their first successful sync. Date, description and location changes stay on Android.
%1$d creations waiting or requiring attention. An uncertain send is never repeated automatically.
System synchronization needs attention. Your Android data is retained.

Simple timed or all-day events without repeats, reminders, guests or custom colors. Includes Proton events and Android-created events after their first successful sync. A title changed together with the description or location is included. Date changes and deletions stay on Android.
Read-only by default. Creation, title-only changes and description or location changes each need their own option. Other edits and deletions stay on Android; pending work is retained.
For title-only changes to simple events. Use the separate text option for description and location changes. Date changes and deletions stay on Android.
